impact: Entry 17 sanctioned POSIX ~ expansion on Windows, which README.md:58 advertises as supported (x64+arm64). Python there uses ntpath.expanduser, which ignores HOME entirely, reads USERPROFILE / HOMEDRIVE+HOMEPATH, treats backslash as a separator, and resolves ~user differently — so the port can read a different session tree than usage.py. FILED as ISS-013 rather than fixed: expandUser predates T-006 (T-003 wrote it; T-006 corrected only the POSIX tails), and no measurement could back an implementation here since the reference interpreter never runs on Windows. Entry 17 rewritten to record it as a KNOWN GAP, explicitly NOT a sanctioned delta — sanctioning a divergence on an advertised platform would be overclaiming.
title: [platform-compatibility] Entry 17 sanctioned POSIX ~ expansion on Windows, which README.md:58 advertises
